name: dialog
title: Dialog
summary: A focused task over the page; the page waits until it closes.
use_when: A short task that needs the whole attention: confirm, choose, edit one thing
avoid_when: Long forms or reading: use a page or a Sheet

copy.title: Names the task
copy.action: A verb that names the result

a11y: Focus is trapped and returns to the trigger (Radix)
